commit.subject: LU-17916 obdclass: fix dt_index_page_adjust() w/ 64K PAGE_SIZE
commit.message:
LU-17916 obdclass: fix dt_index_page_adjust() w/ 64K PAGE_SIZE

It has been reported that builds with 64K PAGE_SIZE fail, as "pages"
in dt_index_page_adjust() is undeclared; fix this by using
kmap_local_folio(), instead of kmap_local_page().

HPE-bug-id: LUS-12384
Fixes: 37cd57fac9 ("LU-17916 mdt: switch to struct folio order 0")
Reported-by: Chris Horn <chorn@ddn.com>
Signed-off-by: Nikitas Angelinas <nikitas.angelinas@hpe.com>
Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity clientarch=aarch64 clientdistro=rocky9.5
Change-Id: I1edc56f1ae45a70c0228324ce0576d48c1c1d306
